                poly = path.to_polygons()

                    # The first of the list is the exterior ring :
                    exterior = poly[0]
                    # Other(s) are hole(s):
                    if len(poly) > 1:
                        holes = [h for h in poly[1:] if len(h) > 3]
                mpoly.append(Polygon(exterior, holes))
            except:
                print('Warning: Geometry error when making polygon #{}'
                      .format(i))
        if len(mpoly) > 1:
            mpoly = MultiPolygon(mpoly)
            polygons.append(mpoly)
            colors.append(polygon.get_facecolor().tolist()[0])

            polygons.append(mpoly[0])

                # in case if m and i not equal and not more then one element left then construct list which include that element

			break  # break the loop from iterating any further
